notes.title: The official version of "Blazing Crow" is online! !
notes.notes:
Hello friends,
The official version 1.0 of "Blazing Crow" is released!

In this version, you can experience:

The ending of the story mode, the crow has somehow completed his growth;


Rogue mode-endless challenge, in which you complete random levels and gradually advance on three large maps...
Try to approach the human living area and turn the world upside down!

https://ice.frostsky.com/2024/08/17/4db85123b078b4a062ddb00cea480644.jpeg

There will also be random challenges in the rogue mode. Completing them will get you cute or weird crow skins.
https://ice.frostsky.com/2024/08/17/e4724b3e94304f8071665a66c30fc8a5.jpeg

Use these unlocked skins to play as a unique crow and continue fighting!
https://ice.frostsky.com/2024/08/17/7a773e59f5bc2e074f4aeb677e736a01.jpeg

You can have fun at once anyway, come and play!

notes.title: Weekly Update --- Blazing Crow V0.4
notes.notes:
New levels:
Four new story levels have been added.

In addition, our endless mode is being developed step by step...

Please look forward to it,
From the quiet suburbs, the strange hybrid zone, to the human settlement -
The crows fly by, leaving behind a sea of ​​fire;
And the crows also change and grow during the journey.
https://ice.frostsky.com/2024/07/11/98b3f0402f0718f062d0a8061e332798.gif

notes.title: Weekly Update --- Blazing Crow V0.3
notes.notes:
New levels:
Four new story levels have been added.

Function optimization:
1 Added level dates displayed in the "Crow Calendar"

2 The game icon has been changed (not the hexagon of Unity, but now it is a cute little crow)

Bug fixes:
Fixed the bug that "restarting after winning and then failing will result in not being able to enter the next level"

notes.title: Weekly Update --- Blazing Crow V0.2
notes.notes:
Fix the resolution problem of the help interface
Adjust enemy AI (it should be obvious)
Try to fix the crow jumping in place (may not be solvedːsteamsadː)
The diary will now automatically turn pages and go directly to the last page
According to the rules, branches cannot be thrown into a grid that already has branches
Fix the problem of the branch throwing prompt box unexpectedly appearing when undoing
Modified some levels (We will add more levels on the next update!)
